person.description: Who the message is to: {name, role?} or a plain string.

company.description: Where they work: {name, domain?} or a plain string.

evidence.description: The facts to build on, pasted as text (an account brief, trigger events, notes). Cited as input:evidence.

channel.description: email: subject + body of at most 120 words. linkedin_dm: body of at most 300 characters, no subject.

voice_samples.description: Messages the sender wrote before; the draft matches their voice. Empty: neutral voice.

offer.description: What the sender sells, in a sentence or two.

sender_name.description: How to sign the message. Absent: no name in the sign-off.

now.description: Current time, ISO 8601, for report.meta. Optional: on JoyStream the template binds it to the run start time, and without it the skill uses the run start time from its instructions. Never guessed.
